messages:
frank: quick note from today's UX pass: copy and reveal affordances in the keys table are confusing on mobile. the inline copy icon disappears behind swipe gestures.
talia: saw this too. on narrow screens we should always show a persistent Copy button to the right of the masked key, no hover dependence.
mei: accessibility: make Copy focusable and include `aria-label=\"Copy API key to clipboard\"`. reveal should open a modal (not tooltip) with `role=dialog` and `aria-modal=true`.
sec-bot: security: disallow auto-reveal on mobile unless user verified via MFA in-session. log all reveal events with actor, device, and IP.
ui-bot: checklist: 1) persistent copy button on mobile 2) reveal via modal w/ ttl 20s 3) aria-labels and focus trap 4) MFA gating + audit log 5) adjust empty state CTA to live above banner.
frank: thanks. i'll update the ticket with copy: "Show credential" -> "Reveal credential (requires MFA)" and mockups for mobile. goal: reduce accidental exposure and make copy available without extra gestures.
